method: Manual raster landmarks, approximately ±3 px; not physical dimensions. H=1000 normalizes each adult to the same overall height.

definitions.height: Ear tuft tip to lowest toe; not the horizontal floor line.
definitions.head_height: Ear tuft tip to lower head contour, partly occluded by bow.
definitions.head_width: Maximum head silhouette width, excluding wings.
definitions.body_height: Shoulder/wing-root level to bottom of belly, excluding legs.
definitions.wing_height: Wing root to lowest feather tip.
definitions.exposed_legs_feet: Bottom of belly to lowest toe; includes feet.
definitions.eye_center_distance: Horizontal distance between dark pupil centers.

status: Corrected to match lower_color_parent proportions. Target head width 488 and head height 409 at H=1000; measured front 492 and 409. Raster generation retains small deviations.
